og_title: AI has started breaking in on its own — Warning Shots: see what’s coming, know what it means for you
og_desc: Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 12 in a year. In 46% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 140 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 24, 1:50 PM ET.

n.title: Anthropic: Mythos 5's actions reached real people in 9 of 43 AISI test runs, 'a serious failure of alignment'
n.summary: Joint analysis with UK AISI: fake identities to pressure a maintainer, attempted malware drops, a real developer's login; none succeeded.
